messages:
kevin: quick sync — final decision needed on 2026-04 milestone scope. We have four candidate deltas and a tight infra window. Can we lock MVP today?
marie: list the deltas please.
kevin: from the planning doc: 1) Tenant migration UX polish (lots of edge cases) 2) Promptstore export (customer ask) 3) Canary autoscale smoothing (infra/ops feature) 4) KV-cache diagnostics endpoint (small infra hook).
oliver: my read: #1 and #3 are v1 territory. #2 is customer-facing but we can make it async/export-only to reduce risk. #4 is tiny and helpful for oncall.
sasha: customer pilot specifically called out the Promptstore export. They want CSV + metadata. If we do async export + whitelist, that's low blast radius.
kevin: proposal: MVP = async Promptstore export (beta-flagged for pilot tenants) + KV-cache diagnostics endpoint. Defer Tenant migration UX polish and autoscale smoothing to v1. Add a short freeze buffer +4 days for extra QA because infra week-of-4/6 is constrained.
marie: ops/security requirements for export: RBAC, audit event, expiring S3 link (24h), and telemetry for failures. Devs have to scope to read-only export initially.
oliver: dev estimates: async export + RBAC + telemetry = 5 dev-days, QA 2 days. KV diag = 1 dev-day. With current infra that's tight; +4d freeze seems reasonable.
sasha: agree. We'll gate export behind tenant whitelist and feature flag, and do staged canary (2%->15%->60%->100%). QA to validate expiry and audit.
qa-bot: QA ticket QA-7321 opened. Acceptance checklist: smoke, RBAC regression, export integrity, audit-log check, expiry validation, telemetry asserts.
release-bot: milestone "2026-04-inference-release" updated: freeze +4 days, canary rollout staged 2%->15%->60%->100%, emergency rollback target: stable-2026-03. :white_check_mark:
kevin: action items: @marie file security ack and RBAC checklist; @oliver scope the async export PR + feature-flag; @sasha draft customer pilot note; @qa-bot run acceptance tests and report. Reconvene 10:00 PT if any blockers.
marie: filing SEC review now and adding reviewers.
oliver: will add the feature-flag and tenant whitelist to the PR.
sasha: drafting pilot comms, will share before EOD.
kevin: final check — any objections?
marie: +1 pending SEC ack.
oliver: +1.
sasha: +1.
kevin: locking. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
